certificate.module_name: HPE Juniper Networking vSRX Virtual Firewall
certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11.1 of the Security Policy.
certificate.description: The HPE Juniper Networking vSRX Virtual Firewall running Junos OS 24.4R1-S3.7 offers the functionality of Juniper's hardware SRX Series Services Gateways in a virtual machine (VM) format. It includes firewall, routing, VPN, Intrusion Detection and Prevention (IDP), and monitoring functionalities.
